name: Matrix.represents_iff'
statement: Matrix ι ι R} {f : Module.End R M} : A.Represents b f ↔ ∀ j, ∑ i : ι, A i j • b i = f (b j)

name: Matrix.isRepresentation.toEnd_exists_mem_ideal
statement: Module.End R M) (I : Ideal R) (hI : LinearMap.range f ≤ I • ⊤) : ∃ M, Matrix.isRepresentation.toEnd R b hb M = f ∧ ∀ i j, M.1 i j ∈ I
